functional_requirements.title: Temperature-at-arrival projection
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall project temperature-at-arrival for each milk tanker in transit using existing IoT telemetry (temperature sensors, GPS) and thermal decay modeling.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tanker in transit with active temperature and GPS telemetry, the system calculates and stores a projected arrival temperature within 60 seconds of receiving new telemetry data.
The projection incorporates current temperature, GPS location, estimated time to arrival, and thermal decay model parameters.
The projected temperature-at-arrival is updated continuously as new telemetry data arrives during transit.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Core predictive capability explicitly stated in value proposition; foundational for all alert and intervention features.

functional_requirements.title: Safe limit breach alert triggering
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall trigger an alert when the projected temperature-at-arrival will breach safe limits defined for milk quality preservation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a projected temperature-at-arrival that exceeds the configured safe limit threshold, the system generates an alert within 10 seconds of the breach condition being detected.
The alert includes tanker identifier, current location, projected arrival temperature, time until arrival, and breach severity.
No alert is triggered when projected temperature-at-arrival remains within safe limits.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Direct consequence of temperature projection; enables real-time intervention per value proposition.

functional_requirements.title: Real-time alert delivery to truck supervisors
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall deliver real-time alerts to truck supervisors when quality risk is detected during transit.
acceptance_criteria: Given an alert triggered by the system, the alert is delivered to the assigned truck supervisor's device within 15 seconds of alert generation.
The truck supervisor receives the alert via the Truck Supervisor App with visual and audible notification.
Alert delivery status (delivered, failed, acknowledged) is logged for each alert.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Truck supervisors are primary action-takers per target user definition; real-time delivery is critical for intervention window.

functional_requirements.title: Cooler degradation detection
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall detect degrading cooler performance by analyzing temperature telemetry patterns over time.
acceptance_criteria: Given historical temperature telemetry for a bulk cooler spanning at least 7 days, the system identifies performance degradation patterns (e.g., increasing temperature variance, longer cooling cycles, elevated baseline temperature).
Degradation detection results include cooler identifier, degradation indicators detected, severity level, and trend analysis.
Detection runs automatically on a daily schedule for all monitored coolers.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Predictive maintenance capability stated in value proposition; enables proactive equipment intervention.

functional_requirements.title: Predictive maintenance alerts for degrading coolers
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall generate predictive maintenance alerts for maintenance teams when degrading cooler performance is detected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a cooler with detected performance degradation, the system generates a maintenance alert within 1 hour of degradation detection.
The alert includes cooler identifier, location, degradation indicators, recommended maintenance actions, and urgency level.
Maintenance alerts are delivered to the assigned maintenance team via the maintenance interface.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Maintenance teams are defined target users requiring predictive alerts per problem statement.

functional_requirements.title: Quality-assurance intervention logging
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall log quality-assurance interventions that saved milk batches for farmer visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a quality-risk alert followed by a documented intervention (reroute, prioritization, expedited processing), the system logs the intervention with timestamp, action taken, tanker identifier, batch identifier, and outcome.
Logged interventions are associated with the affected farmer or farmer cooperative for subsequent visibility.
Intervention logs are retained for at least 12 months and are queryable by batch identifier and farmer identifier.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Farmers need visibility into interventions per target user definition; supports transparent quality accountability.

functional_requirements.title: Root-cause attribution for rejected batches
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall provide transparent root-cause attribution for rejected batches to distinguish farmer-side issues from transit or equipment failures.
acceptance_criteria: Given a rejected or downgraded milk batch, the system generates a root-cause attribution report identifying the failure point (farmer cooler, transit conditions, equipment failure, or receiving plant conditions).
The attribution is based on telemetry data, alert history, and quality test results, with supporting evidence included in the report.
The root-cause report is accessible to the affected farmer or farmer cooperative via the Farmer App within 24 hours of rejection.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Farmers require transparent attribution per target user definition; addresses financial accountability for quality failures.

functional_requirements.title: Advance warning to plant operations for at-risk loads
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall provide advance warning to plant operations and quality assurance teams when at-risk loads are en route.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tanker with an active quality-risk alert, the system notifies the destination plant operations team at least 30 minutes before projected arrival.
The notification includes tanker identifier, projected arrival time, risk level, projected temperature-at-arrival, and recommended handling actions (immediate processing, prioritized offloading).
Plant operations can acknowledge and respond to the notification via the plant operations interface.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Plant operations teams are defined target users benefiting from advance warning per target user section.

functional_requirements.title: DPDP Act 2023 consent mechanism
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall implement consent mechanisms compliant with DPDP Act 2023 for collection and processing of personal data from farmers, truck supervisors, and maintenance personnel.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user (farmer, truck supervisor, maintenance personnel), the system presents a consent request in clear language specifying data types collected, processing purposes, retention period, and data principal rights before any data collection begins.
The user can grant or deny consent; denial prevents data collection and system access for that user.
Consent records (granted/denied, timestamp, consent version) are stored and auditable for each user.
functional_requirements.reasoning: CON-01 and OR-02 mandate DPDP Act 2023 compliance; consent is a foundational data protection obligation.

functional_requirements.title: Data principal rights mechanisms
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall implement data principal rights mechanisms compliant with DPDP Act 2023, including access, correction, erasure, and data portability.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data principal request for access, the system provides a complete copy of their personal data in a structured, commonly used format within 7 days.
Given a data principal request for correction or erasure, the system processes the request and confirms completion within 14 days, subject to legal retention obligations.
Data principal rights requests are logged with request type, timestamp, requestor identifier, and resolution status.
functional_requirements.reasoning: CON-01 and OR-02 mandate DPDP Act 2023 compliance; data principal rights are mandatory obligations.

functional_requirements.title: Data localisation within India
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall host and process all personal data within India to comply with DPDP Act 2023 cross-border data transfer restrictions.
acceptance_criteria: All personal data storage infrastructure (databases, file storage, backups) is physically located within India.
All personal data processing (computation, analytics, model training) occurs on infrastructure located within India.
Data residency is verified through infrastructure audit logs and hosting provider certifications confirming Indian data center locations.
functional_requirements.reasoning: CON-02 and OR-03 mandate data localisation to eliminate cross-border transfer risk; architectural constraint.

functional_requirements.title: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance for Truck Supervisor App
functional_requirements.statement: The Truck Supervisor App interface shall meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards as required by RPwD Act 2016.
acceptance_criteria: All interface elements include text alternatives for non-text content (images, icons, alerts).
All functionality is operable via keyboard navigation without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes.
Color contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA minimum requirements (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).
The interface is compatible with common screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, TalkBack) as verified by accessibility testing.
functional_requirements.reasoning: CON-08 and OR-04 mandate WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance for public-facing digital services per RPwD Act 2016.

functional_requirements.title: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance for Farmer App
functional_requirements.statement: The Farmer App interface shall meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards as required by RPwD Act 2016.
acceptance_criteria: All interface elements include text alternatives for non-text content (images, icons, quality reports).
All functionality is operable via keyboard navigation without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes.
Color contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA minimum requirements (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).
The interface is compatible with common screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, TalkBack) as verified by accessibility testing.
functional_requirements.reasoning: CON-08 and OR-04 mandate WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance; Farmer App is plausibly public-facing per vision.

functional_requirements.title: Per-state regulatory compliance configuration
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall support per-state regulatory compliance configuration to accommodate varying state-level dairy and APMC rules.
acceptance_criteria: The system maintains a configurable regulatory rule set for each operating state, including state-specific data retention requirements, reporting obligations, and operational constraints.
System behavior (data handling, reporting, alert thresholds) adapts automatically based on the state in which an operation occurs, determined by GPS location or plant assignment.
Regulatory configuration changes are version-controlled and auditable, with effective dates and change history logged.
functional_requirements.reasoning: CON-04 and OR-01 identify multi-state regulatory exposure as a binding constraint requiring per-state mapping and compliance.

functional_requirements.title: CERT-In cybersecurity incident reporting
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall implement cybersecurity incident detection and reporting mechanisms compliant with CERT-In requirements within 6 hours of incident detection.
acceptance_criteria: The system detects and logs cybersecurity incidents (unauthorized access attempts, data breaches, service disruptions) in real time.

Given a detected cybersecurity incident meeting CERT-In reporting thresholds, the system generates an incident report including incident type, timestamp, affected systems, impact assessment, and containment actions.
The incident report is submitted to CERT-In within 6 hours of incident detection via the prescribed reporting channel.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Regulatory posture identifies CERT-In incident reporting as a precedented operational requirement.

functional_requirements.title: Thermal decay model validation against actual arrival temperatures
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall validate thermal decay model accuracy by comparing projected temperatures against actual arrival temperatures measured at receiving plants.
acceptance_criteria: For each tanker arrival, the system records the projected temperature-at-arrival (from the last projection before arrival) and the actual measured temperature at the receiving plant.
The system calculates model accuracy metrics (mean absolute error, root mean square error, percentage within ±1°C tolerance) on a rolling 30-day window.
Accuracy metrics are reported daily to system administrators and flagged when accuracy falls below a configurable threshold.
functional_requirements.reasoning: OR-05 identifies thermal decay model accuracy as unvalidated and critical for operational trust; Phase 1 dependency.

functional_requirements.title: Alert threshold tuning based on pilot data
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall support alert threshold tuning based on pilot operations data to balance sensitivity versus specificity and minimize false alarms.
acceptance_criteria: Alert thresholds (temperature limits, time-to-breach windows, degradation severity levels) are configurable parameters stored in the system configuration.
The system provides an administrative interface for adjusting alert thresholds with justification and effective date.
Threshold changes are version-controlled and auditable, with before/after alert rate metrics tracked for each threshold adjustment.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Phase 2 roadmap explicitly requires alert threshold tuning based on pilot data to optimize sensitivity vs. specificity.

functional_requirements.title: IoT data quality validation
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall validate IoT telemetry data quality (temperature sensors, GPS) and implement fallback logic for sensor failures or data gaps.
acceptance_criteria: The system validates each incoming telemetry data point for completeness (required fields present), plausibility (values within physically reasonable ranges), and timeliness (timestamp within acceptable delay threshold).

Given a sensor failure or data gap detected (missing data, implausible values, stale timestamps), the system logs the data quality issue and applies fallback logic (use last known good value, interpolate from adjacent readings, or suppress projection if data gap exceeds threshold).
Data quality metrics (uptime, completeness, plausibility failure rate) are tracked per sensor and reported daily.
functional_requirements.reasoning: OR-07 identifies IoT data quality as unassessed and critical for alert accuracy; Phase 1 pilot dependency.

functional_requirements.title: Baseline rejection and save rate tracking
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall track baseline rejection rates and successful save rates to enable measurement against North-Star Metrics NSM-01 and NSM-02.
acceptance_criteria: The system records each milk load arrival with outcome classification (accepted, rejected, downgraded, saved-by-intervention).
Rejection rate (percentage of loads rejected or downgraded) and save rate (percentage of at-risk loads successfully saved) are calculated on a rolling 30-day window.
Baseline and current metrics are reported weekly to product and operations teams for North-Star Metric tracking.
functional_requirements.reasoning: NSM-01 and NSM-02 require baselining in Phase 1; tracking is foundational for measuring product impact.

functional_requirements.title: Alert accuracy tracking against actual arrival conditions
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall track alert accuracy by comparing alerts triggered against actual arrival conditions to measure North-Star Metric NSM-03.
acceptance_criteria: For each alert triggered, the system records whether the projected temperature breach matched actual arrival conditions (true positive, false positive).
For loads that arrived with quality issues but no alert was triggered, the system records a missed detection (false negative).
Alert accuracy (percentage of alerts where projected breach matched actual conditions) is calculated on a rolling 30-day window and reported weekly.
functional_requirements.reasoning: NSM-03 requires alert accuracy baselining in Phase 1; critical for operational trust and avoiding alert fatigue.

Trigger alerts when safe limits will be breached, while providing cooler degradation detection and farmer-facing root-cause attribution
DPDP Act 2023 obligations (consent, purpose limitation, data principal rights) are manageable with standard controls
Truck Supervisor App and Farmer App interfaces to meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards
